ai.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
ai.brief: Bland, the San Francisco voice-AI company, has released Tofu-1 , a full-duplex speech-to-speech model in research preview. The Tofu-1 speech-to-speech model targets calls from moving cars, hospital rooms and weak-signal lines. It listens while it speaks and reasons while it talks. For phone-agent teams, one model now handles audio in and audio out, with no transcript between. com chrome extension . What is Tofu-1? Tofu-1 is a full-duplex speech-to-speech model from Bland that hears, reasons and replies in audio during phone calls. It is the first release in a planned family of Bland speech-to-speech models. How does Tofu-1 differ from a cascade voice agent? Most voice agents are cascades. They turn speech into text, pass it to a language model, then turn the reply back into speech. Tofu-1 listens to the audio directly , so tone, hesitation and background sound stay available to the model.

sec.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
sec.brief: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. In a FLASH advisory released Friday, the agency said multiple threat actors have weaponized the open-source framework since at least August 2026 to target organizations across the financial, government, technology, defense, healthcare, and other sectors. "ARTEX significantly reduces the time required to chain attack techniques, with some intrusions progressing from initial targeting to privileged access in under three hours," reads the FBI advisory. " ARTEX is an autonomous penetration testing framework written in Go that uses artificial intelligence agents to perform reconnaissance, discover vulnerabilities, exploit systems, escalate privileges, and steal data with little human intervention.
